thread:
megan (Product): Quick sync — field asks for a low-risk upgrade path for on-prem customers with strict IP/peering controls. Can we outline options for shiproom?

ravi (Eng Infra): Two technical paths: 'side-by-side' (dual-stack handshake + routing proxy) or 'in-place agent upgrade'. Side-by-side needs extra IPs/peering; in-place needs migration scripts and a quiesce window (~5m).

carla (Field SE): Customer T says zero downtime. They can tolerate a 30s slow-down but will not accept IP changes — hostname/IP must remain.

sam (Security): Security note: KMS rotation mustn't break bootstrap flow. Also need immutable audit events for node upgrades (S3 + syslog).

megan (Product): Draft launch criteria thought: 1) automated rollback <= 15m, 2) connectivity & end-to-end validation suite, 3) customer-run preflight signoff. Any gaps?

jen (DevEx): DevEx: we need a single preflight command that outputs a deterministic checklist + diffs. Example: ```preflight --manifest customer.yaml``` -> shows missing ports: 7443, 10250 and suggested NAT mapping.

carla (Field SE): :thumbsup: That will save a lot. Quick ask — tenant isolation: some customers want per-tenant subnets vs overlay namespaces. What do we recommend for GA?

ravi (Eng Infra): Overlay (CNI namespaces + RBAC) is fastest to ship. Per-tenant subnets require IPAM + per-tenant peering changes and will add ~4 weeks to delivery.

megan (Product): Tradeoff call: GA = overlay + strict ACLs + clear docs; roadmap = per-tenant subnets as Enterprise add-on. We should document limits (static IPs, port reservations).

carla (Field SE): If we go overlay for GA, produce a "Fasthandshake" runbook for field with NAT-mapping workaround for customers needing stable external IPs.

sam (Security): Fallback policy idea: if onprem handshake fails, route traffic to hosted fallback for affected tenant for up to 48h. Need legal/ops review for residency exceptions.

legal-bot: Heads up — hosted fallback will need a short DPA addendum & opt-in consent. I will prep a template and tag @megan.

megan (Product): Next steps: @ravi draft upgrade playbook + quiesce steps; @jen scope preflight UX + CLI output; @carla capture top 3 customer constraints and example manifests. Reconvene Thu 11 PT to approve GA checklist.

deploy-bot: Reminder: #shiproom sync Thu 11:00 — https://calendar.redwood/shiproom
